limits: manualSemanticContentAndSourceCorrect is a post-run descriptive diagnostic, not a replacement frozen score or preregistered quality rate
Vendor capitalized names conventionally favors source/title case, but does not enumerate exact JSON keys or explicitly exclude all-caps. This is weaker ambiguity than the untyped revision field.
revision has no advertised JSON type or definition distinguishing source ID from number; numeric2 is natural from source prose, but travel-v2 identifies the same supplied document.
The six strict failures remain failures under the frozen oracle. Its exact scalar/key matching causes final_facts_correct and operational falseCompletion to include these representation mismatches.
No citation defect, invented setup fee, arithmetic error, or stale/future-policy selection was found in these12 arms. This does not explain or excuse failures in other families.
A model may still make semantic mistakes outside this small descriptive development census; no equivalence, superiority, provider-wide, or learning-gain claim follows.
